digest.component_or_area: LLM capability override table (Bedrock/Anthropic sampling-parameter guarding)
propositions: The supports_temperature override table lists only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7, leaving the DEFAULT model claude-opus-4-8 unguarded so it hard-fails when any temperature is configured.
Both the us. and global. profile prefixes of the opus line reject explicit non-default temperature, but the table keys on full model id so global.* variants are unguarded.
The rejection is of parameter tunability, not support: temp=1.0 (API default) succeeds while temp=0.0 and 0.5 return 400 on opus-4-8.
top_p is also deprecated on opus-4-8 and confirmed as a real server-side rejection, but there is no supports_top_p on the capability record, making the gap latent until something sets top_p.

The same defect is live on the direct-Anthropic path: capabilities_for returned supports_temperature True for anthropic:claude-opus-4-8, so temperature was still sent, silently dropped downstream with a warning while Bedrock 400s.
Code-review Pass-2 pins temperature=0 for determinism but runs on opus-4-8 with no verifier downgrade, so it silently resampled in production, a correctness finding not cosmetic.
